mapper.sql: SELECT m.id, m.erp_menu_id, m.erp_source_id, m.daou_document_id, m.daou_form_code, f.form_name, m.status, m.draft_user_id, m.title, m.content_html, m.created_at, m.updated_at FROM erp_approval_mappings m LEFT JOIN eap_form_config f ON f.form_code = m.daou_form_code

SELECT m.id, m.erp_menu_id, m.erp_source_id, m.daou_document_id, m.daou_form_code, f.form_name, m.status, m.draft_user_id, m.title, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS content_html, m.created_at, m.updated_at FROM erp_approval_mappings m LEFT JOIN eap_form_config f ON f.form_code = m.daou_form_code
mapper.select:
m.status IN ('WRITING', 'DRAFT', 'TEMPSAVE', 'INPROGRESS')
m.status IN ('WRITING', 'DRAFT', 'TEMPSAVE', 'INPROGRESS', 'COMPLETE', 'RETURN', 'CANCEL')
m.status IN ('TEMPSAVE', 'DRAFT')
m.status = 'WRITING'
m.status = 'COMPLETE'
m.status = 'CANCEL'
1 = 1
ORDER BY m.created_at DESC, m.id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO erp_approval_mappings ( erp_menu_id, erp_source_id, daou_document_id, daou_form_code, status, draft_user_id, title, content_html, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{erpMenuId}, #{erpSourceId}, #{daouDocumentId}, #{daouFormCode}, #{status}, #{draftUserId}, #{title}, #{contentHtml}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE erp_approval_mappings SET status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE daou_document_id = #{documentId}
UPDATE erp_approval_mappings SET daou_document_id = #{daouDocumentId}, status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE erp_approval_mappings SET title = #{title}, content_html = #{contentHtml}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND UPPER(COALESCE(status, '')) = 'WRITING'
